name: Exact Rational Ray-Surfel Evaluation
definition: A method to compute the intersection of a viewing ray with a flat surfel rectangle in its local (u, v) coordinates, using a homography approximation around the center of the screen-space bounding box to avoid per-pixel cross products and divisions.
summary: Exact Rational Ray-Surfel Evaluation computes precise ray-surfel intersections using a homography approximation to replace expensive cross products, reducing computational cost while maintaining visual fidelity.
